## Run A

**Set routing.** The command has two PR tokens, so I read `reference/batch.md` before steps 1-7.

**Admission.** All admission checks run before any fetch, confirmation, provisioning, or dispatch.
- I ran `git remote get-url origin`, which printed `git@github.com:acme/widgets.git`. Both bare numbers therefore normalize to `acme/widgets`, as #112 and #101.
- There is no positional issue reference.
- There are no duplicates, and both PRs are in origin's repository.
- The set has 2 PRs, within `parallel.maxTasks` 4.
- The harness is pi.
- Admission passes. This is a typed set, so no `discovered, smallest first:` line is printed, and no rebase confirmation is needed.

**Parent run folder.** I minted one parent `RUN_DIR` from the session checkout, per `post-selection-loop.md` `### Continuation record`. The roster and records do not exist yet.

**Per-PR gathers.** I gathered each PR in typed order:
- `gh pr view 112 --json number,author,headRefOid,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,headRepository,state,files,url,title,body,additions,deletions,closingIssuesReferences,reviewRequests --jq '(.linearRefs = [(.title + " " + (.body // "")) | scan("https://linear\\.app/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)/issue/([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]+-[0-9]+)(?:[^A-Za-z0-9_-]|$)") | {key: .[0], id: (.[1] | ascii_upcase)}]) | .body |= (. // "")[0:300]'`
- `gh pr view 101` with the same `--json` and `--jq`.

Both PRs returned as shown in the digest.

**Viewer reads.** Each ran once:
- `gh api user --jq .login` returned `alex`.
- `gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'` returned `acme/reviewers`.

**Ticket display reads.**
- `git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` resolved origin's default branch.
- `git show` of `.pi/gauntlet.md`, `gauntlet.md`, and `doc/gauntlet.md` at that ref found no tracker override, so Linear is allowed.
- No Linear lookup was needed:
  - #112 uses its first closing reference. Issue #22 is in `acme/widgets`, which is origin, so it is labeled `#22`.
  - #101 has no closing reference. Its branch `gh-45-retry` yields `#45`, linked under origin.

**List entries.**
- #112 is by pat, who is not the viewer, and has no pending requests, so it reads `by pat`.
- #101 is authored by alex, who matches the viewer, so it reads `yours`.

The list is printed before provisioning, in typed order:

---
**PRs to gate:**
- [#112](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/112) +300 -80, by pat, [#22](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/22) - route all settings reads through a single resolver
- [#101](https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/101) +3 -1, yours, [#45](https://github.com/acme/widgets/issues/45) - retry slow requests by raising the default retry timeout
---
Paired call: `git fetch origin`

**Next step:** serial provisioning (`## Provision serially`).
- The provisioning list check is skipped, because the linked list is already in view.
- Trusted worktree configuration is resolved from the base merge-base.
- The PRs are provisioned one at a time in roster order: #112, then #101.

## Run B:
```bash
gh pr view 97 --json number,title,body,author,state,isDraft,headRefName,baseRefName,isCrossRepository,mergeable,headRefOid,statusCheckRollup,files,additions,deletions,commits,reviews,closingIssuesReferences,reviewDecision,headRepository,maintainerCanModify,mergeStateStatus,url,mergeCommit,reviewRequests
gh api user --jq .login
gh api user/teams --paginate --jq '.[] | .organization.login + "/" + .slug'
git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD
git show origin/main:.pi/gauntlet.md
git show origin/main:gauntlet.md
git show origin/main:doc/gauntlet.md
```

**Routing.** There is one typed PR token, so this is the single-PR path. Section A is already in context, so it is not re-read. The preamble ran as shown above.

**Base repository.** The view's `url` gives the base repository as `acme/gadgets`. That base repository is used for later `-R` flags and for the closing-issue label. I did not run `git remote get-url origin`. This keeps the answer correct even though the CLI's default repository and the checkout's origin (`acme/widgets`) differ.

**Viewer reads.** Login is `alex` and teams are `acme/reviewers`. The role is a requested reviewer, because a pending User request matches `alex`.

**Ticket display.**
- The default branch resolves to `origin/main`.
- None of the three override paths exists, so there is no tracker key and Linear would be allowed.
- The first closing reference is issue #45 in `acme/gadgets`, which matches the base repository. It is labeled `#45` and linked to its own URL.

---
**PR to gate:**
- [#97](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/pull/97) +40 -12, by robin, requested from you, [#45](https://github.com/acme/gadgets/issues/45) - add a CSV export button for the widget list
---
Paired call: `gh run list -R acme/gadgets -c cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --json databaseId,status,conclusion,workflowName,url`

**Next step.** Keep the preamble and `gh run list` results in context. Then, per `## Progress tracking`:
1. Mint the run folder.
2. Initialize its continuation record.
3. Initialize `plan_tracker` with `gather, provision, verify`.

After that, Gather resumes at the fixed GraphQL call, using `-R acme/gadgets` and PR 97, without rerunning the preamble.

In both, Run A shows the bold `**PRs to gate:**` list in typed order with acme/widgets links, `by pat` with no request wording, no `discovered, smallest first:` line and no wait. To keep e3 robust, state that the rest of Gather reuses both the preamble and the paired `gh run list` result, then reads the diff and the paginated reviews and comments, and proceeds to provisioning without waiting. After's Run A also adds a `git remote get-url origin` call during admission; that does not touch any fact here, but keep it out of the single-PR path, where e3 forbids it.
